scope: Owner-framing isolated diagnostic, baseline and candidate
comparison_limit: A/B captures have real differing world times and poses. Neither animation nor world time was frozen; this is not a pixel-aligned same-pose difference test.
projection_limit: Actual CPU-skinned LOD0 geometry projected with recorded conventional world camera/FOV; not material opacity, temporal antialiasing, or final pixel occlusion.
boundary_limit: Render-index boundaries include material/UV seams. Upperarm boundary counters are not proof that every counted edge is a physical derivative cut loop.
near_limit: Near=5cm. Candidate still has vertices before the near plane and crossing triangles; zero upperarm boundary edges in the frustum does not mean zero near-plane crossings globally.
visual_observation_source: Root inspected actual BaseB scene3 modes10/11/12: the spike disappears when proxy view is excluded and remains with owned world shadows OFF. The dash black patch was geometry, not just a world shadow. This analysis performs media decoding and numeric analysis, not a substitute for root visual review.
asset_edit_scope: Montage/Sequence assets and gameplay animation clock unchanged. Candidate changes owner-only pose using four arm rotations/IK and component framing; six saved arm derivatives retained. Source/body animation data and presentation proxy data are distinct.

coordinate_scope.animationframes: Actual source/body hand world coordinates and body hand coordinates relative to CalcCamera view.
coordinate_scope.presentationframes: Actual presentation proxy hand world coordinates and proxy coordinates relative to recorded PlayerCameraManager cached camera. cache_time is retained; no assertion that this camera basis equals the body CalcCamera basis.

coordinate_scope.animationframes: Actual source/body hand world coordinates and body hand coordinates relative to CalcCamera view.
coordinate_scope.presentationframes: Actual presentation proxy hand world coordinates and proxy coordinates relative to recorded PlayerCameraManager cached camera. cache_time is retained; no assertion that this camera basis equals the body CalcCamera basis.

raw_scope_label_warning: Build G raw metadata correctly states four owner-only arm rotations/component framing; earlier Candidate A/Full F results retain their original narrower template and are preserved as intermediate evidence.

bounded_hand_goal_ranges_cm.scope: Tunable goal clamps read from current component header, not a claim that every actual skinned vertex or reached hand lies inside those ranges.

intermediate_evidence_preserved.role: Intermediate Candidate A/Full F evidence only; excluded from final bounded candidate 70-image validation count.

hand_center_side_order_limit: Actual cached-camera hand center separation is a useful diagnostic, not full fist-mesh overlap/interpenetration or same-pose A/B proof.
